fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309516/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and 2027: PeakSingleCampsite $10) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sarahs-creek-campground ('All camp sites are $10.00/night'), read 2026-10-30

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sarahs-creek-campground ('The Interagency Senior and Access Passes ... entitle the pass holder to a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-30

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sarahs-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Open year-round') + recreation.gov rates (Peak Season Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2026-2028) and calendar (all 19 sites available through January 2027), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservation only since January 1, 2025 ('There will no longer be any First Come/First Service'), online or at 877-444-6777. 14 nights in any 30 days on Chattahoochee-Oconee NF land, then leave the forest for 30 days. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 12:01 pm.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sarahs-creek-campground ('Starting January 1, 2025, All Camping will be by Reservation Only. There will no longer be any First Come/First Service.'; 'The maximum stay is 14 day') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309516 (notice 'All camping at Sarah's Creek Campground is by reservation only, make reservations online at recreation.gov or by calling 877-444-6777'; maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; minConsecutiveStay 1 soft = no rule), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309516/campsites + RIDB catalog (all 19 public sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 19 bookable sites plus 3 management sites (10, 11, 21); the FS page says 22-site. Spread in three sections along FS-156 over ~1.1 km (sites 1-5 south, 6-13 middle, 14-22 north). The catalog states no length or equipment for 18 of the 19; site 1 permits only tent, pickup camper and pop-up (16 ft), Max Vehicle Length 30, back-in.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309516 ('The campground is broken up into 3 sections on that road') + /campsites (per-site type, coordinates, permitted_equipment) + RIDB catalog, read 2026-10-30. The stored 26-ft max came from note prose and no official page states it, so it is cleared.

values.note: Two vault toilets, one near the entrance and one across a water crossing near site 17; bear-resistant trash bins.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309516 ('There are two vault toilets in the campground, the first one close to the entrance to the campground and the second located across a water crossing near site #17. There are bear-resistant trash bins') + FS page ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-30

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Chattooga River RD, off Warwoman Rd via FS-156 / Sarah's Creek Rd (gravel, tight/narrow). No ATVs, UTVs or golf carts in the campground or on Forest Service roads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $10 (2026-2027), reservation-only on rec.gov (fcfs never), no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water, Senior/Access 50%. Added year-round season (FS page + rec.gov calendar), 14-night max; count 22 -> 19 bookable (3 are management sites); cleared the unsourced 26-ft max (no official page gives a length). Note trimmed of field facts and the RV Life line.
flags: FIT QUESTION: recreation.gov's catalog lists no equipment and no length for 18 of the 19 bookable sites; the one site that has them (site 1) permits only tent, pickup camper and pop-up (16 ft), Max Vehicle Length 30 ft. No RV/motorhome or trailer type appears anywhere, and neither the FS page nor rec.gov states a rig length. The stored ~26-ft max had no official source and is cleared.

Access wording: neither the FS page nor rec.gov says anything about the condition of FS-156 (no gravel, narrow, 4WD or length wording); directions only: 'Turn left on Forest Service Road 156 aka Sarah's Creek Road ... approximately 2.2 miles ahead'. The note's 'gravel, tight/narrow' is unsourced on these pages but left.
Missing phone: Chattooga River Ranger District 706-754-6221 (FS alerts 'Contact Number: 706-754-6221'; the Sarah's Creek FS page gives no phone; rec.gov gives only the 877-444-6777 reservation line).

Pin 34.92607,-83.26297 sits at the southern section (50 m from site 3). The sites run 1.1 km north along FS-156 in three sections; the per-site centroid is 34.93077,-83.26575 (581 m NNW). The pin at the first section is defensible; moving it to the centroid would put it on the road between sections. Not a split candidate (one facility, one road, one fee).
